items.exampleEn: Who was the winner of the game?
The championship game is on Saturday.
Our school gives an award to the best student every year.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校每年都會頒獎給最優秀的學生。

items.exampleEn: The Olympic flag has five rings.
items.exampleZh: 奧運會旗上有五個圓環。

items.exampleEn: I rented skis at the hotel.
Running is a cheap and easy sport.
items.exampleZh: 跑步是便宜又簡單的運動。

items.exampleEn: Her medals are on the wall of her room.
items.exampleZh: 她的獎牌掛在她房間的牆上。

items.exampleEn: Ice hockey is very popular in Canada.
items.exampleZh: 冰上曲棍球在加拿大非常受歡迎。

items.audioEn: The winner of the championship gets a medal and some money.
items.audioZh: 冠軍賽的贏家可以得到一面獎牌和一些獎金。
items.questionZh: 冠軍賽的贏家會得到什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Running every morning makes me feel great.
items.sentenceZh: 每天早上跑步讓我覺得很舒服。

items.sentenceEn: Our school has a hockey team.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校有一支曲棍球隊。

items.stemEn: She won a gold ____ in swimming.
items.stemZh: 她在游泳項目贏得一面金牌。

items.stemEn: She won the ____ for best singer of the year.
items.stemZh: 她贏得了年度最佳歌手獎。

items.passageEn: Lisa loves winter sports. When she was young, her father gave her a pair of skis. Now she is twenty, and she has won many medals. Last year, she was the winner of the national championship, and the city gave her an award. Her dream is to go to the Olympic Games.
items.passageZh: Lisa 很愛冬季運動。她小時候，爸爸送了她一副滑雪板。現在她二十歲，已經贏過很多獎牌。去年她拿下全國冠軍賽的冠軍，市政府還頒了一個獎給她。她的夢想是參加奧運。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 小時候爸爸送她什麼？

items.promptZh: 他贏得了游泳比賽的冠軍。
referenceEn: He won the championship in swimming.
rubricZh: 「贏得冠軍」可寫例如 won the championship、won first place
說過去的事用過去式（例如 won）

referenceEn: He showed the medal to his parents.
He showed his parents his medal.
rubricZh: 可寫，例如 showed the medal to his parents、showed his parents the medal 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 showed、has shown 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「「贏得獎牌」用 win（過去式 won）」寫死動詞；題目說「誰得過獎牌」，got／received a medal 也正確；建議改「例如 win／won、get a medal」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "「得到獎牌」可寫例如 win／won a medal、get／got a medal"（原 "「贏得獎牌」用 win（過去式 won）"）；放寬動詞（第③關 FIX 同）
